mentions.name: THINK
mentions.description: A modern CSS-first UI framework built on semantic HTML, custom elements, and data attributes, using :has(), container queries, and density scaling with no classes and no build step. Includes a data table component and automated Insights that provide quick insights on loaded data.
mentions.problem: The author always wanted a minimalistic CSS framework for their projects, so they started creating their own.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I always wanted a minimalistic CSS framework for my projects, so I started to create my own: THINK

THINK is a modern CSS-first UI framework built on semantic HTML, custom elements, and data attributes. Uses :has(), container queries, and density scaling. No classes, no build step.
